terms.comment: Our preferred transparent formation for a slender cylindrical rod, such as the metal rod used with curtain rings; for the photographed slender metal rod it is preferred. The individual nouns are ancient; virga aulaeī, pertica aulaeī and canālis aulaeī are transparent modern formations, and no strong lexicographic evidence was found that any one of them is an established traditional term.
Useful especially when the support is longer, thicker or more pole-like.

phrases.english: The curtain hangs from the rod.

sources: Lewis & Short: virga · Lewis & Short: pertica · Morgan–Owens: rod
